profile_text.body:
Twilio Inc is a public company, traded under the ticker TWLO, headquartered in San Francisco, California, and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001447669. According to its website, it sells APIs for SMS, RCS, voice, and email, along with conversational AI and identity verification, aimed at customer engagement.

The company describes its platform as built for engagement in the agentic era, connecting communication channels, customer context, and AI in one place. It says AI agents draw on internal knowledge and real-time data, that they hand conversations to human staff when complexity or customer intent calls for it, and that transfers carry full context so customers do not repeat themselves. Twilio describes its plans as flexible with pay-as-you-go pricing.

A legal exposure record associated with the company lists 264 matters in California.
